reply: I will await your return. Chase Opponent helps you follow fast creatures. Bring me meat or ham when you return.
Standing here all day makes me hungry. Could you help me find some food?
That smells delicious. Ask me for a trade and I will pay two gold pieces for each piece of meat or ham.
Welcome, |PLAYERNAME|. As a tailor and merchant, I can show you how to change your outfit. Shall I?
Hunt rabbits or deer, loot them, and bring me a piece of meat or ham. I will pay you for it.
Choose an outfit and colours that suit you. You can open Set Outfit from your character's menu. Try it and talk to me again.
Welcome back, |PLAYERNAME|. That is how trading works. You are ready to cross the bridge to Rookgaard. Take care!
That is how trading works. You are ready to cross the bridge to Rookgaard. Follow the path to the northwest. Good luck, |PLAYERNAME|!
Take this club, then go downstairs in my house. Bring three cockroach legs as proof.
Your coat is with you and your armor slot is occupied. Ready for action?
Your coat is with you and your armor slot is occupied. Ready for action?
Watch your health bar. Shall I show you how food helps you recover?
You can find food on creatures in the forest. Have you seen Zirella nearby?
Take this fish. Use it from your inventory to eat and start recovering health. Easy, yes?
Welcome to Rookgaard, |PLAYERNAME|. Could you help me? Say yes if you can.
Your quest log records your progress. Visit the chest upstairs in my house and return wearing its coat.
There are more dangerous monsters beyond this tutorial. May I demonstrate why you should watch your health?
You brought three cockroach legs. Here are 100 experience points. Did you see your level advance?
Advancing improves your health, carrying capacity and speed. Did the cockroaches hurt you?
Zirella lives east of here, down the mountain. Please visit her and ask whether she needs help.
I need firewood for my oven. Will you help me?
Find a dead tree without leaves in the forest to the south.
Use the dead tree to break a branch from it.
Move the branch across the ground, then use it with my cart.
Drag and drop the branch across the grass until it is near my cart.
Use a dead tree, drag its branch across the map, and use that ground branch with my cart.
Thank you for the firewood. You earned 50 experience points, and may take what is in the chest beside my bed.

Nature's blessings! You may find the desperate wolf mother in the south of Cormaya. You will know the place because there is a big stone that looks like a grumpy face. ...

At night it will weep bloody tears and only at night you will meet the ghost there. Take this talisman so you may be able to talk with animals and even plants and stones. Just don't expect that all of them will answer you.

Thank You! Their lamentation lapsed into silence. Thus, I assume you brought them some relief. Here, take this map part in return. I'm not interested in this treasure anymore. I just want to return to our hidden realm. ...
Search for the last part somewhere in the Fields of Glory. It's hidden in a big fly agaric.
This is everything that remained of my cloak? That's terrible! However, I guess I can put the feathers together again. Yes, that should be enough feathers. ...

Please give them to me so I can restore my cloak. But don't watch me! Swan maidens don't like to be observed. Nature's blessings, human being. I will tell Ikassis that you have been of great assistance.
Thank you, mortal being! The fae will be forever grateful. Take this blossom bag as a little thank-you gift. Such blossoms grow on our trees just once in a decade, so they are quite rare.

That's wonderful! Now you will be able to repair the magical barrier. You have to strengthen the arcane sources that power this mystic shield. There are three different arcane sources: the moon sculptures, the dream bird trees and the sun mosaics. ...

There are five of each of them and you have to find them all to repair the barrier. Spread the gathered moon rays on the moon sculptures. Pour out the starlight over the dream bird trees and let the sunlight shine on the mosaics. ...
If you charge all fifteen arcane sources with the respective light, Feyrist's protection will be ensured again.
We are so happy. Now Aurita can take a walk on the beach. But I still can't visit her secret underwater grotto. To achieve this, we need something else: a very rare plant called raven herb. ...

If eaten it allows an air breathing creature to breathe underwater for a while. Please find this plant for me. But know that you'll only find it at night. It resembles a common fern but its leaves are of a lighter green.
Thank you, friend! Now I can visit Aurita in her underwater grotto!
Oh, I see! You really found all the teeth for me! Thank you, human being! Please take this in return.

Thank you very much, human being! You have to find three children: Quero's daughter in Thais, Allen's son in Venore and Rowenna's daughter in Carlin. Go to their bedrooms and find their milk teeth. ...
Usually they put them on their bed stands. Then you have to put the gifts on their beds. Please take these presents and go to Thais, Carlin and Venore. Come back with the milk teeth.

You're bringing the milk teeth! Thank you, human being; you were of great assistance to me! Please take this in return. It's the part of a map. If you find the other parts, it will show you the way to a hidden fairy treasure. ...
Oh, and if you're interested, there's still another {cause} you could help me with.

Oh what a beautiful story. ... *yawn* Here, take this map part. We have no need for it when we are slumbering. *yawn* Some of our siblings have the third part. They took over a couple of stones in the north of some high mountains. ...
There are ... dwarves I guess. ... Zzzzzz ...
Here is the item you need. Thank you for helping Feyrist.
